scenario: saying you are hungry or thirsty
english_title: Recognising and Responding to Saying You Are Hungry or Thirsty
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: food & drink — saying you are hungry or thirsty
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to saying you are hungry or thirsty; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan tells Ms Anna she is quite hungry right now.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nói với chị Anna là mình đang khá đói.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Anna, I am quite hungry right now.
turns.vietnamese: Anna này, tôi đang đói bụng lắm.

turns.speaker: Ms Anna
turns.english: So am I. Shall we find some food?
turns.vietnamese: Tôi cũng vậy. Mình đi tìm gì ăn không?
